from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = 9
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            count = sum(v != bg for row in tile for v in row)
            tiles.append((count, r0, r1, c0, c1, tile))
    source = max(tiles, key=lambda t: t[0])
    _, _, _, _, _, pattern = source
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for _, r0, r1, c0, c1, _ in tiles:
        for i in range(r1-r0):
            for j in range(c1-c0):
                out[r0+i][c0+j] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-6fc09535.py'; p.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),ns)
demo_in=[[1,9,0,7,9,9,9,0],[9,1,9,9,9,9,9,9],[9,9,7,7,9,6,9,6],[9,9,7,9,9,9,5,9],[9,9,7,6,9,9,7,9],[4]*8]+[[9]*8 for _ in range(5)]
demo_out=ns['transform'](demo_in)
print('reproduces demo:',demo_out==demo_in[:6]+[row[:] for row in demo_in[:5]])
